name: today
title: Today
subtitle: Arrivals, departures, who is in and what needs a person

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Record checks first, then the money and the follow-ups.
sections.sql: select area, subject, item, due_on from v_attention order by rank, due_on nulls last

sections.title: Arriving today and tomorrow
sections.sql: select starts_on as arrives, site, pet, owner, phone, coalesce(nullif(vaccine_gap(pet_id, starts_on), ''), 'current') as vaccination, run from v_stays where status = 'booked' and starts_on between current_date and current_date + 1 order by starts_on, site, pet

sections.title: Going home today
sections.sql: select site, run, pet, owner, phone, charge_cents, currency from v_stays where status = 'checked-in' and ends_on <= current_date order by site, pet

sections.title: In house
sections.sql: select site, run, pet, feeding, medication, behaviour, to_char(last_check, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as last_check from v_in_house order by site, run

sections.title: Nights at 80% or more
sections.sql: select night, to_char(night, 'Dy') as day, site, service, booked, capacity, free from v_occupancy where pct >= 80 order by night, site

sections.title: By week
sections.sql: select to_char(date_trunc('week', night), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as week_of, site, service, sum(booked)::int as booked_nights, sum(capacity)::int as capacity_nights, round(100.0 * sum(booked) / sum(capacity)) as pct from v_occupancy group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1, 2, 3

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: Each finding with the rule and its source

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule, subject, site, finding, due_on, source from v_compliance order by rule, due_on

sections.title: Vaccination due before a booked stay
sections.sql: select pet, owner, phone, starts_on, vaccine_gap(pet_id, starts_on) as missing_at_arrival from v_stays where status = 'booked' and vaccine_gap(pet_id, starts_on) <> '' order by starts_on
